title: The Horizon of Sector Nine Revisited
author: Petra Voss
blurb: Ansel Pemberton, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
